hadiths.arabicText: عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ , وَقَالَ الْحَسَنُ : " تَحُلُّ الْقَارِعَةُ قَرِيبًا مِنْ دَارِهِمْ "
hadiths.english_translation: From Ma'mar, and Al-Hassan said: 'The calamity will descend near their dwelling.'

hadiths.arabicText: عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ , عَنْ قَتَادَةَ , فِي قَوْلِهِ تَعَالَى : حَتَّى يَأْتِيَ وَعْدُ اللَّهِ سورة الرعد آية 31 , قَالَ : " فَتْحُ مَكَّةَ "
hadiths.english_translation: From Ma'mar, from Qatadah, regarding Allah's saying: 'Until the promise of Allah comes' (Surah al-Ra'd verse 31), he said: 'The conquest of Makkah.'

hadiths.arabicText: عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ , عَنْ قَتَادَةَ , فِي قَوْلِهِ تَعَالَى : أَفَمَنْ هُوَ قَائِمٌ عَلَى كُلِّ نَفْسٍ بِمَا كَسَبَتْ سورة الرعد آية 33 , قَالَ : " اللَّهُ تَعَالَى قَائِمٌ عَلَى كُلِّ نَفْسٍ "
hadiths.english_translation: From Ma'mar, from Qatadah, regarding Allah's saying: 'Is then He Who stands over every soul (to watch) what it earns?' (Surah al-Ra'd verse 33), he said: 'Allah Most High is standing over every soul.'

hadiths.english_translation: From Ma'mar, from Qatadah, regarding Allah's saying: 'And to Him is the final return' (Surah al-Ra'd verse 36), he said: 'To Him is the return, the destination of every servant.'

hadiths.arabicText: عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ , عَنْ قَتَادَةَ , فِي قَوْلِهِ تَعَالَى : يَمْحُو اللَّهُ مَا يَشَاءُ وَيُثْبِتُ سورة الرعد آية 39 , قَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ : " هُوَ الْقُرْآنُ ، كَانَ اللَّهُ يَمْحُو مَا يَشَاءُ وَيُثْبِتُ ، وَيُنْسِي نَبِيَّهُ صلى الله عليه وسلم مَا شَاءَ , وَيَنْسَخُ مَا شَاءَ ، وَهُوَ الْمُحْكَمُ ، وَعِنْدَهُ أُمُّ الْكِتَابِ " , قَالَ : " جُمْلَةُ الْكِتَابِ وَأَصْلُهُ "
hadiths.english_translation: From Ma'mar, from Qatadah, regarding Allah's saying: 'Allah erases what He wills and confirms' (Surah al-Ra'd verse 39), Ibn Abbas said: 'It is the Quran. Allah used to erase what He willed and confirm, and cause His Prophet ﷺ to forget what He willed, and abrogate what He willed. And it is the firm (part), and with Him is the Mother of the Book.' He said: 'The totality of the Book and its foundation.'

hadiths.arabicText: عَنْ مُعْتَمِرٍ , عَنْ أَبِيهِ , عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ , قَالَ : " الْكِتَابُ كِتَابَانِ : كِتَابٌ يَمْحُو اللَّهُ مِنْهُ مَا يَشَاءُ وَيُثْبِتُ , وَعِنْدَهُ الأَصْلُ أُمُّ الْكِتَابِ "
hadiths.english_translation: From Al-Mu'tamir, from his father, from 'Ikrimah, he said: 'The Book is two books: a book from which Allah erases what He wills and confirms, and with Him is the original, the Mother of the Book.'

hadiths.arabicText: عَنْ مُعْتَمِرٍ , عَنْ أَبِيهِ , قَالَ : سُئِلَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ , عَنْ أُمِّ الْكِتَابِ , فَقَالَ : قَالَ كَعْبٌ : " خَلَقَ اللَّهُ الْخَلْقَ وَعَلِمَ مَا هُمْ عَامِلُونَ , ثُمَّ قَالَ لِعِلْمِهِ : كُنْ كِتَابًا ، فَكَانَ كِتَابًا "
hadiths.english_translation: From Al-Mu'tamir, from his father, he said: Ibn Abbas was asked about the Mother of the Book, so he said: Ka'b said: 'Allah created the creation and knew what they would do, then He said to His knowledge: Be a book, and it became a book.'

hadiths.arabicText: عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ , عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ ، وَعَنِ ابْنِ طَاوُسٍ ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ , قَالَ : " لَقِيَ عِيسَى ابْنُ مَرْيَمَ إِبْلِيسَ , فَقَالَ : أَمَا عَلِمْتَ أَنَّهُ لا يُصِيبُكَ إِلا مَا قُدِّرَ لَكَ ؟ ، قَالَ : نَعَمْ , قَالَ إِبْلِيسُ : فَأَوْفِ بِذِرْوَةِ هَذَا الْجَبَلَ , فَتَرَدَّ مِنْهُ فَانْظُرْ أَتَعِيشُ أَمْ لا ؟ " ، قَالَ : قَالَ ابْنُ طَاوُسٍ , عَنْ أَبِيهِ , فَقَالَ : " أَمَا عَلِمْتَ أَنَّ اللَّهَ ، قَالَ : لا يُجَرِّبُنِي عَبْدِي ، فَإِنِّي أَفْعَلُ مَا شِئْتُ ؟ " ، قَالَ : وَأَمَّا الزُّهْرِيُّ ، فَقَالَ : " إِنَّ الْعَبْدَ لا يَبْتَلِي رَبَّهُ , وَلَكِنَّ اللَّهَ يَبْتَلِي عَبْدَهُ " ، قَالَ : " فَخَصَمَهُ "
hadiths.english_translation: From Ma'mar, from Al-Zuhri, and from Ibn Tawus, from his father, he said: 'Jesus son of Mary met Iblis, and he (Iblis) said: Do you not know that nothing will befall you except what has been decreed for you? He said: Yes. Iblis said: Then climb to the peak of this mountain and throw yourself down from it and see if you will live or not.' He said: Ibn Tawus said, from his father, so he (Jesus) said: 'Do you not know that Allah said: My servant shall not test Me, for I do what I will?' He said: As for Al-Zuhri, he said: 'Indeed, the servant does not test his Lord, but Allah tests His servant.' He said: 'So he defeated him.'
